raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicated txn_ids in raw_transactions are re-delivered corrections: the two copies differ only in amount and record_version (2 supersedes 1), and silver keeps both. Deduplicating silver to the highest record_version per txn_id removes the duplicates, and the gold tables rebuild from the corrected silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) = 1;"}}
